Sonar Sweep.name: Sonar Sweep
Sonar Sweep.description: The user sends out a string of clicks and reads the echoes: underwater out to a harbor's width, on land across a building's floor. They learn the layout, where every person and vehicle is, including anyone trapped in a sunken car, an air pocket or rubble, and who is moving; darkness, mud and smoke do not block it. Strain: moderate.
